title: Implement bcrypt credential checker with constant-time comparison
description:
What: Implement an async credential check function that verifies username+password against bcrypt-hashed entries, using constant-time comparison for the username lookup.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/session/commands/auth.rs (or a new file auth_store.rs):
   a. Define CredentialStore { entries: HashMap<String, String> } where value is bcrypt hash
   b. fn CredentialStore::load_from_config(users: &[UserConfig]) -> Self
      - For each user: store (lowercase username, bcrypt_hash) pair
   c. async fn CredentialStore::check(username: &str, password: &str) -> bool:
      - Look up by normalized username
      - If not found: call bcrypt::verify("dummy", dummy_hash) to prevent timing oracle on username
      - If found: call bcrypt::verify(password, stored_hash).unwrap_or(false)
      - Do NOT short-circuit on username not found without doing a bcrypt verify (timing attack)
2. Add CredentialStore to ServerStores:
   pub credential_store: Arc<CredentialStore>
   Populated from config.auth.users in new_mem() (can be empty)
3. The credential check in dispatch.rs currently calls check_credentials() which does string ==
   Change it to call ctx.credential_store.check(user, pass).await
Defensive: always call bcrypt::verify even when user not found (use a hardcoded dummy hash); username comparison is case-insensitive; never log passwords.
Acceptance: test_wrong_password_rejected and test_correct_password_accepted pass; cargo test clean.
